description: This file defines the 'ReceiptsAdd' fragment class used in an Android application for handling receipt image capture, upload, and database update operations within the transportation management system.

classes.name: ReceiptsAdd
classes.description: A Fragment class for adding receipts, allowing users to capture or upload receipt images, input receipt details, and upload them to a server.

methods.name: newInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the ReceiptsAdd fragment.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Inflates the fragment layout and sets up UI event listeners.

methods.name: takePicture
methods.description: Initiates camera intent to take a picture and save it to a temporary file.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from camera activity and loads the captured image.

methods.name: uploadBitmap
methods.description: Uploads a bitmap as an image file to a server via a multipart request.

methods.name: getFileDataFromDrawable
methods.description: Converts a Bitmap to a byte array for upload.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns a formatted string representing the current date.

methods.name: updateDatabase
methods.description: Sends receipt details including image URL to server API to update database.

methods.name: createTemporaryFile
methods.description: Creates a temporary file in external storage for capturing images.

methods.name: grabImage
methods.description: Loads an image from a URI into an ImageView, resizing it appropriately.
